description: List the Locker installs this account owns or holds a membership in: the signed run archive, one install per connector (any-HTTP, agent; Zapier, Make and n8n later). Returns installId, endpointId, platform, name, relation (owner or member), runs kept, the chain head, the allowance pooled across the account, and actions (the reader, the key page, the plan page). Read-only. The runs themselves are captures on the install's endpointId, so list_captures and get_capture read them too; get_locker_run reads one with its receipt.
name: list_locker_installs
title: List locker installs
